about_the_game:
**A viral outbreak has turned the world into chaos... and even Tung Tung Tung Sahur was not spared.**

After being infected and captured, Tung finds himself locked deep within a mysterious dungeon. Determined and alone, he sets out on a challenging journey to reunite with his lost friends – Tralalero, Tralala, and Bombardino Crocodilo – members of the Italian Brainrot Team.

Leap, run, and survive through trap-filled ruins, harsh weather conditions, collapsing platforms, and unpredictable hazards. The world is unforgiving – but Tung never gives up.

🌪️ Third-person, precision-based platforming

⚔️ Dodge deadly traps and solve movement-based challenges

🧩 Navigate parkour-style obstacle courses with skill and timing

🎮 Experience unique environments across handcrafted levels

🧠 Simple controls, deep challenge – one mistake can cost everything

**Will you help Tung Tung Tung Sahur survive and reunite with his friends?**

---

🧟 Coming updates will include new levels, mechanics, and unexpected twists.

**This is not just a platformer. This is a brainrot escape mission.**

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 veya AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 Ti Or AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 1400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No internet connection required
  • Additional Notes: Low-spec systems may experience reduced performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i5-10400
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER or equivalent
  • Storage: 1400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No internet connection required
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for smooth performance on mid to high-end systems.

short_description: Escape a deadly dungeon as Tung Tung Tung Sahur, the last survivor of a brainrot zombie outbreak. Dodge deadly traps, jump through chaotic levels, and reunite with your lost friends in this fast-paced, physics-based 3D platformer full of absurd charm and challenge.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
